answer: Graduated work ladder grants weight only from verified completions: new keys start at zero, each tier needs 20 attested jobs, a per-identity bond, and a submission rate cap. A sybil ring cannot reach a 12-member quorum because weight never transfers along a referral thread; a bridge identity admitted contributes only its earned weight, and the timber, slashable bond collateral backing fake attestations, is forfeited. Every attempt costs a fresh bond and weeks of verified work, so coordinated fakes are priced out.
